scope: E3 right-rail + purchase modal against build-loop specs

findings.claim: AcceptanceGateModal is defined inside right-rail.tsx (architectural gap)
findings.detail: function AcceptanceGateModal declared at right-rail.tsx:225, used at :588. No top-level PurchaseFlowModal component exists in apps/web/src/components/. No Steps 2/4/5/6 modal surfaces exist.

findings.claim: Stepper opens at Math.max(min, 2.0) violating 'opens at minimum' lock
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx:482 — `React.useState<number>(Math.max(minInvestmentPct, 2.0))`. purchase-content-spec.md:77 says 'open value: min (NOT max(min, 2.0) — fix queued)'.

findings.claim: minInvestmentPct hardcoded to 1.0 in marketplace page
Fine-print line 'Min X% · Step Y% · Max Z%' shown instead of locked copy
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx:531-535 renders Min/Step/Max strip. purchase-content-spec.md:95 locks copy as 'Minimum investment {min}% · Stake available {max}% · Contact us for more info'.

findings.claim: availablePct <= 0 falls back to 10.0 instead of ClosedCampaignCard
findings.detail: marketplace/[slug]/page.tsx:217 — `availablePct > 0 ? availablePct : 10.0`. purchase-content-spec.md:122 locks 'a 0-available open campaign should not render a buyable rail; treat as Fully Subscribed'.
mystable/page.tsx has zero references to `checkout` or `searchParams.checkout`. purchase-content-spec.md:265,270 flags 'success state not implemented (mystable/page.tsx ignores ?checkout=success)'.

findings.claim: Stepper state machine with 5 error states missing
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx has zero matches for `INVALID_STAKE|reduce.*your.*stake|increase.*your.*stake|must.*be.*a.*multiple`. purchase-content-spec.md:80-89 lists 5 states (over-max, under-min, non-multiple, empty/revert, max-stake-reached).

findings.claim: Stripe error -> investor copy mapping table missing
findings.detail: create-session/route.ts has only 1 match for the listed error codes (PURCHASES_DISABLED at :82). purchase-content-spec.md:218-227 maps 7 codes (401/403/400/404/409×2/503×3/500). Front-end copy never appears.

findings.claim: 75% return row uses text-status-active green accent (LOCKED)
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx:82,100 use status-active badge for rail KPIs, but the modal summary block doesn't contain the 'Investor Return 75% of gross prize money' green row from spec:41. Modal AcceptanceGateModal lacks the full Step 2 term sheet, so the row isn't reachable.

findings.claim: Summary block 4 rows (Initial Payment, Monthly, Lease, Investor Return) present in modal
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx:0 matches for the 4 row labels. These belong in the Step 2 term-sheet modal which does not exist as a component.

findings.claim: KYC prompt (Verify Identity CTA) inside acceptance modal on 403 KYC_REQUIRED
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx has 0 matches for `Verify Identity|KYC_REQUIRED|kyc_required`. purchase-content-spec.md:164-180 locks this UI path inside the modal.

findings.claim: Modal size LOCKED max-w-lg x h-[720px]
findings.detail: right-rail.tsx has 0 matches for `max-w-lg` or `h-[720px]`. purchase-content-spec.md:34 locks the size for all popups Steps 2-6.

apps/web/src/components/ contains zero files matching *purchase* or *Purchase*. Only right-rail.tsx (with embedded AcceptanceGateModal). Steps 2 term-sheet, 4 verify, 5 pay, 6 own modal surfaces are entirely absent.

evidence_edges.reason: AcceptanceGateModal function declared inside the rail file
Only 1 of 7 spec'd codes surfaces in code
status-active badge in rail but modal row missing
0 matches for the 4 summary row labels
no files matching purchase pattern; ls returned empty
